name: source_coverage_before_local_filter
sql:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    cells.municipality AS "cells.municipality"
  FROM cells AS cells
  WHERE
    cells.report_year >= 2024 AND cells.report_year <= 2025
  GROUP BY
    cells.municipality
), _cm_cells__id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality AS (
  SELECT
    cells.municipality AS "cells.municipality",
    COUNT(DISTINCT cells.id) AS "cells.expected_cells"
  FROM cells AS cells
  WHERE
    cells.report_year >= 2024 AND cells.report_year <= 2025
  GROUP BY
    cells.municipality
), _cm_cells__staff__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality AS (
  SELECT
    cells.municipality AS "staff.cells.municipality",
    COUNT(DISTINCT staff.cell_id) AS "staff.cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_cells_municipality"
  FROM staff AS staff
  LEFT JOIN cells AS cells
    ON staff.cell_id = cells.id
  WHERE
    cells.report_year >= 2024 AND cells.report_year <= 2025
  GROUP BY
    cells.municipality
), _cm_cells__staff__iif_education_absent_category_stock_null_sum AS (
  SELECT
    cells.municipality AS "staff.cells.municipality",
    SUM(CASE WHEN staff.education = 'absent_category' THEN staff.stock ELSE NULL END) AS "staff.iif_education_absent_category_stock_null_sum"
  FROM staff AS staff
  LEFT JOIN cells AS cells
    ON staff.cell_id = cells.id
  WHERE
    cells.report_year >= 2024 AND cells.report_year <= 2025
  GROUP BY
    cells.municipality
)
SELECT
  _base."cells.municipality",
  _cm_cells__staff__iif_education_absent_category_stock_null_sum."staff.iif_education_absent_category_stock_null_sum" AS "cells.filtered_value",
  COALESCE(
    _cm_cells__staff__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality."staff.cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_cells_municipality",
    0
  ) AS "cells.source_cells",
  COALESCE(_cm_cells__id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality."cells.expected_cells", 0) AS "cells.expected_cells"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_cells__id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality
  ON _base."cells.municipality" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality."cells.municipality"
LEFT JOIN _cm_cells__staff__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality
  ON _base."cells.municipality" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__staff__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality."staff.cells.municipality"
LEFT JOIN _cm_cells__staff__iif_education_absent_category_stock_null_sum
  ON _base."cells.municipality" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__staff__iif_education_absent_category_stock_null_sum."staff.cells.municipality"

name: source_coverage_with_category_and_coarse_denominator

measures.name: cars_per_1000
measures.formula: 1000 * sum(iif(vehicles.kind == 'car', vehicles.n, None)) / nullif(sum(population.n, partition_by=[municipality, year(period_start)]),0)

sql:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    cells.municipality AS "cells.municipality",
    vehicles.kind AS "cells.vehicles.kind",
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start) AS "cells.period_start"
  FROM cells AS cells
  LEFT JOIN vehicles AS vehicles
    ON cells.id = vehicles.cell_id
  WHERE
    (
      cells.period_start >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND cells.period_start < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    cells.municipality,
    vehicles.kind,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start)
), _cm_cells__id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start AS (
  SELECT
    cells.municipality AS "cells.municipality",
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start) AS "cells.period_start",
    COUNT(DISTINCT cells.id) AS "cells.expected_cells"
  FROM cells AS cells
  WHERE
    (
      cells.period_start >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND cells.period_start < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    cells.municipality,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start)
), _cm_cells__population__n_sum_partition_by_municipality_period_start AS (
  SELECT
    cells.municipality AS "population.cells.municipality",
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start) AS "population.cells.period_start",
    CAST(SUM(population.n) AS DOUBLE) AS "population.n_sum_partition_by_cells_municipality_cells_period_start"
  FROM population AS population
  LEFT JOIN cells AS cells
    ON population.cell_id = cells.id
  WHERE
    cells.period_start >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND cells.period_start < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    cells.municipality,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start)
), _cm_cells__vehicles__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start AS (
  SELECT
    cells.municipality AS "vehicles.cells.municipality",
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start) AS "vehicles.cells.period_start",
    COUNT(DISTINCT vehicles.cell_id) AS "vehicles.cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_cells_municipality_cells_period_start"
  FROM vehicles AS vehicles
  LEFT JOIN cells AS cells
    ON vehicles.cell_id = cells.id
  WHERE
    cells.period_start >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND cells.period_start < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    cells.municipality,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start)
), _cm_cells__population__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start AS (
  SELECT
    cells.municipality AS "population.cells.municipality",
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start) AS "population.cells.period_start",
    COUNT(DISTINCT population.cell_id) AS "population.cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_cells_municipality_cells_period_start"
  FROM population AS population
  LEFT JOIN cells AS cells
    ON population.cell_id = cells.id
  WHERE
    cells.period_start >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND cells.period_start < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    cells.municipality,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start)
), _cm_cells__staff__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start AS (
  SELECT
    cells.municipality AS "staff.cells.municipality",
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start) AS "staff.cells.period_start",
    COUNT(DISTINCT staff.cell_id) AS "staff.cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_cells_municipality_cells_period_start"
  FROM staff AS staff
  LEFT JOIN cells AS cells
    ON staff.cell_id = cells.id
  WHERE
    cells.period_start >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND cells.period_start < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    cells.municipality,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start)
), _cm_cells__vehicles__iif_kind_car_n_null_sum AS (
  SELECT
    cells.municipality AS "vehicles.cells.municipality",
    vehicles.kind AS "vehicles.kind",
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start) AS "vehicles.cells.period_start",
    SUM(CASE WHEN vehicles.kind = 'car' THEN vehicles.n ELSE NULL END) AS "vehicles.iif_kind_car_n_null_sum"
  FROM vehicles AS vehicles
  LEFT JOIN cells AS cells
    ON vehicles.cell_id = cells.id
  WHERE
    cells.period_start >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
    AND cells.period_start < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  GROUP BY
    cells.municipality,
    vehicles.kind,
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', cells.period_start)
)
SELECT
  _base."cells.municipality",
  _base."cells.vehicles.kind",
  _base."cells.period_start",
  1000 * _cm_cells__vehicles__iif_kind_car_n_null_sum."vehicles.iif_kind_car_n_null_sum" / NULLIF(
    NULLIF(
      _cm_cells__population__n_sum_partition_by_municipality_period_start."population.n_sum_partition_by_cells_municipality_cells_period_start",
      0
    ),
    0
  ) AS "cells.cars_per_1000",
  COALESCE(
    _cm_cells__vehicles__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start."vehicles.cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_cells_municipality_cells_period_start",
    0
  ) AS "cells.vehicle_cells",
  COALESCE(
    _cm_cells__population__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start."population.cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_cells_municipality_cells_period_start",
    0
  ) AS "cells.population_cells",
  COALESCE(
    _cm_cells__staff__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start."staff.cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_cells_municipality_cells_period_start",
    0
  ) AS "cells.staff_cells",
  COALESCE(
    _cm_cells__id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start."cells.expected_cells",
    0
  ) AS "cells.expected_cells"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_cells__id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start
  ON _base."cells.municipality" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start."cells.municipality"
  AND _base."cells.period_start" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start."cells.period_start"
LEFT JOIN _cm_cells__population__n_sum_partition_by_municipality_period_start
  ON _base."cells.municipality" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__population__n_sum_partition_by_municipality_period_start."population.cells.municipality"
  AND _base."cells.period_start" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__population__n_sum_partition_by_municipality_period_start."population.cells.period_start"
LEFT JOIN _cm_cells__vehicles__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start
  ON _base."cells.municipality" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__vehicles__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start."vehicles.cells.municipality"
  AND _base."cells.period_start" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__vehicles__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start."vehicles.cells.period_start"
LEFT JOIN _cm_cells__population__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start
  ON _base."cells.municipality" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__population__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start."population.cells.municipality"
  AND _base."cells.period_start" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__population__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start."population.cells.period_start"
LEFT JOIN _cm_cells__staff__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start
  ON _base."cells.municipality" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__staff__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start."staff.cells.municipality"
  AND _base."cells.period_start" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__staff__cell_id_count_distinct_partition_by_municipality_period_start."staff.cells.period_start"
LEFT JOIN _cm_cells__vehicles__iif_kind_car_n_null_sum
  ON _base."cells.municipality" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__vehicles__iif_kind_car_n_null_sum."vehicles.cells.municipality"
  AND _base."cells.vehicles.kind" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__vehicles__iif_kind_car_n_null_sum."vehicles.kind"
  AND _base."cells.period_start" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_cells__vehicles__iif_kind_car_n_null_sum."vehicles.cells.period_start"
